disclosure: Educational categorization; not a legal classification or advice.

categories.label: Privacy and private life
categories.description: Protection from unnecessary observation, collection, profiling, and exposure.

categories.label: Data control and sovereignty
categories.description: People’s ability to understand, access, correct, delete, and move data about them.

categories.label: Expression and participation
categories.description: The ability to communicate, associate, access information, and appeal platform decisions.

categories.label: Access and inclusion
categories.description: Fair access to essential digital infrastructure and accessible interfaces.

categories.label: Algorithmic accountability
categories.description: Explanation, non-discrimination, human review, and responsibility for consequential automated decisions.

categories.label: Community and collective rights
categories.description: Protection for children, vulnerable people, Indigenous communities, and shared cultural/data interests.
